summary: The diff implements Object.seal in crates/kahvi-builtins/src/object/seal.rs and matches the spec's four steps in order. Step 1 returns non-objects unchanged. Step 2 propagates errors from ops::set_integrity_level(agent, o, Sealed) with `?`. Step 3 throws a TypeError when the status is false. Step 4 returns the object. Each step's comment sits directly above its code, and no other file is touched. The remaining failures in the gate report come from Proxy [[PreventExtensions]] and Object.isSealed being unimplemented, which is an honest not-implemented path, not a defect in this change. I found no special-casing, swallowed errors, made-up values or unrelated edits. The SetIntegrityLevel logic lives in ops and is not part of this diff, so I did not review it.
notes_for_next_attempt: No changes needed for seal.rs. The remaining test262 failures come from unimplemented dependencies: Object.isSealed and Proxy [[PreventExtensions]]. Those belong to other tickets and should keep throwing the not-implemented error.
